note: Weapon bonuses: a weapon holds up to 3, each has 3 levels. levels = damage % at level 1/2/3 ('mult' entries multiply on top: 100 = x2). Confirmed values: Long Range 15@L1/24@L3, Concentrated Attack 10@L1, Risky Reward 50, Ice-Breaker x2..x5 range. Guesses to correct in-game: Long Range L2 (20), Close Combat levels, Concentrated L2/L3 (13/16), Risky Reward L2/L3 (60/70), Ice-Breaker L2 (x3.5).

bonuses.name: Long Range
